items.summary: 本文由 VicOne 为您带来。 VicOne 利用支持物理 AI 生态系统的软件和工具的 AI 辅助研究，在不到两天的时间里确定了 28 个初步的零日发现。其中包括由 Google、NVIDIA 和 Meta 等开发或维护的项目。根据初步验证，所有 28 个发现均被归类为零日漏洞。
items.summary_original: This article is brought to you by VicOne . VicOne identified an initial set of 28 zero-day findings in less than two days using AI-assisted research across software and tools supporting the Physical AI ecosystem. These include projects developed or maintained by Google, NVIDIA, and Meta, among others. Based on initial validation, all 28 findings are classified as zero-day vulnerabilities.

The breakthrough allows scientists to predict how laser pulses behave inside special crystals in just milliseconds, without sacrificing much accuracy. This could dramatically improve the precision and efficiency of powerful X-ray lasers used in cutting-edge scientific research.

items.summary_original: Robotics companies are investing heavily in the belief that data will solve the most difficult problems in robotics. Once AI systems have ingested enough data from human demonstrations, the thinking goes, robots will be able to perform the vast majority of the manual tasks that humans now do. There are even robotics companies that exist solely to collect training data and sell it to other robotics companies in pursuit of this goal.

judgement.summary: 整体多空交织中性：整机产能扩张与海外进厂测试利好上游零部件预期，但租赁价格下行与融资降温压制估值，短期看量产订单兑现。

items.logic: 宇树规划19万台、智元累计下线2万台，整机厂扩产直接抬升对减速器、伺服、丝杠等零部件的采购预期，量产节奏成为估值锚。
日租价从3000元降至1800元、融资普遍下滑，说明终端付费意愿与场景经济性尚未跑通，短期压制租赁与场景运营类公司的订单与估值。
Atlas进入格芯晶圆厂测试、Spot扩大部署，工业检测场景对视觉与力觉传感需求提升，利好传感器环节订单预期。
OpenAI解散独立机器人团队，而DeepMind、华为云等持续迭代机器人大模型，技术路线分化，对软件环节估值影响方向不明。
